name: Christopher Alexander Whitmore
extra_bullets: Prepared the weekly deal tracker for the group head, pulling status updates from six live mandates into a single two-page summary every Friday morning
Collected and coded 2,000 local news articles on wage changes so the professor could compare reported effects across states and industries
Kept a shared log of common writing problems that the center director later used to plan training sessions for new tutors
cover_letter_paragraph: I also care about getting the small things right. In my research job I kept a log of every change I made to the data so the professor could trace each number back to its source, and I brought the same habit to my internship. I would bring that care to every model and page I touch on your team.
